identity.title: [v0.92][WP-22A] Repair quality-gate evidence hydration and release-credit semantics

values.task_boundary: Repair only the v0.92 quality-gate evidence hydration, validator semantics, retained corrective artifacts, and directly supporting docs/tests for #467.
deliverables: deterministic canonical discovery and hydration for 13 feature plus 20 critical-path rows
blocker taxonomy separating accepted, implementation missing, proof missing, stale or non-ancestral evidence, normalization or mapping missing, and explicit planned/deferred states
independent denominator and binding validator with substitution, duplicate, extra, ambiguous, stale, and unclassified-row rejection
completion guard rejecting uninvestigated 100% blocked publication
positive controls from multiple feature and critical-path families

adversarial suite for fabricated accepted rows, suppressed discoverable evidence, normalization-only blockers, stale heads, non-ancestral merges, malformed terminal evidence, check/ruleset substitution, duplicate mappings, and vacuous all-blocked publication
corrected matrix, gate record, blocker report, validation receipt, v0.92 quality/readiness docs, and #311 supersession note
fresh exact-head review and publishable PR closing #467
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The production generator attempts deterministic canonical hydration for all 13 feature rows and 20 critical-path rows; it does not initialize every row to accepted_evidence_packet_missing.

AC-2: Every accepted row binds exact repository, owner, implementation paths, reviewed head, PR head, merge, ancestry, required checks, positive/negative/integration/platform evidence, claim boundary, and typed or explicitly approved recordless terminal authority.

AC-3: Every non-accepted row names the concrete missing implementation, proof, stale authority, explicit planned/deferred state, or unresolved mapping; packet missing alone is not treated as a product failure.

AC-4: The validator independently recomputes the denominator and evidence bindings, rejects self-attested or cross-row/cross-repository substitutions, and fails on missing, duplicate, extra, ambiguous, or unclassified rows.

AC-5: A completion/publication guard rejects a 100% blocked matrix when rows have not undergone evidence discovery and classification; an all-blocked outcome is allowed only when each row has independently verified concrete blockers.

AC-6: Adversarial tests cover fabricated accepted rows, suppressed discoverable evidence, false product blockers caused only by normalization gaps, stale heads, non-ancestral merges, malformed terminal evidence, check/ruleset substitution, duplicate mappings, and vacuous all-blocked publication.

AC-7: Corrected matrix, gate record, blocker report, validation receipt, v0.92 quality/readiness docs, and a #311 supersession note agree exactly and preserve downstream lock only for remaining concrete blockers.
AC-8: One fresh exact-head review audits every row disposition and the discovery-completeness denominator before publication.
dependencies: Current origin/main includes merged #311/PR #466 history as immutable provenance.
Execution depends on merged predecessor work only, not administrative terminal reconciliation or cleanup.
non_goals: No waiver of missing implementation or proof
No rewrite of #311 or PR #466 history
No broad release ceremony or WP-23 documentation pass
No cloud execution, paid runners, or unrelated C-SDLC redesign
